_about: W. B. Yeats (1865-1939) as collector and editor of Irish folk tales, not as poet or playwright: Fairy and Folk Tales of the Irish Peasantry (1888), Irish Fairy Tales (1892) and The Celtic Twilight (1893, enlarged 1902). Clean Gutenberg text; US public domain (all before 1929). Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-02: choose public-domain storytellers batches; Adam may veto).
